newsitem.title: USA: Cirrus Logic agrees to settle suits.
newsitem.headline: Cirrus Logic agrees to settle suits.

text.p: Cirrus Logic Inc. said Tuesday it reached a tentative agreement to settle all the securities lawsuits pending against the semiconductor maker and some of its current and former officers and directors.

The settlement resolves the 1993 and 1995 securities class action lawsuits in federal court, the 1996 securities class action lawsuits in California state court, and the 1996 shareholder derivative lawsuit in federal court.
The lawsuits alleged that the Cirrus and its officers and directors made misleading and deceptive statements about the company that affected its stock price.

In a statement, the Fremont, Calif.-based company did not disclose the amount of the settlement, but it said the deal will not have a material effect on its financial position or results of operations.

The settlement, which is subject to negotiating a final agreement, court approval and other contingencies, will be covered by proceeds from insurance policies plus a contribution from Cirrus Logic. Cirrus' stock fell 75 cents to $19.75 on Nasdaq in late trading.
